source: Current DGI&P and Ministry of Foreign Affairs VPA notices, plus the official Pakistan Online Visa mobile guide, read 2026-08-30. The portal blocks some automated sessions and does not expose readable text-field regexes, character limits or stable validation error strings, so no pattern or maxLength is claimed and no local validator is mounted.

visa_route.label: Visa route and passport eligibility
visa_route.placeholder: Visa-exempt, VPA eligible or regular visa
visa_route.help: Six GCC nationalities are exempt for tourism and business. DGI&P currently lists 120-country VPA eligibility; other travellers must use the applicable regular route.

application_category.label: Application category
application_category.help: Choose VPA and Tourism only when the passport qualifies. Business and Sikh pilgrimage are separate categories.

passport_name.label: Name from passport
passport_name.placeholder: Exactly as shown in the passport
passport_name.help: Use the identity printed in the passport that will be carried to Pakistan.

passport_details.label: Passport details
passport_details.placeholder: Number and document dates from the passport
passport_details.help: Copy the details from the same passport image uploaded with the application.

nationality.label: Passport nationality
nationality.help: Route eligibility follows the passport nationality, not residence or departure country.

passport_image.label: Passport document image
passport_image.placeholder: Clear image requested by the official application
passport_image.help: Upload the requested passport document. No unverified public pixel or file-size limit is claimed here.

live_photograph.label: Live photograph
live_photograph.placeholder: Photograph captured in the official flow
live_photograph.help: The official mobile guide includes a live-photograph step. Follow the current on-screen capture instructions.

email_review.label: Account email and final review
email_review.placeholder: Reachable email used for the application
email_review.help: Review the category, passport and uploads before submission, then monitor the official account and email for the Visa Grant Notice.
